headline_pain: Worried About Going Too Far West?
primary_text: "I need something close to the freeway and port." What if your warehouse was minutes from all three — Princes Freeway, West Gate Tunnel, and Port of Melbourne? That's Truganina. Not some isolated industrial estate on the fringe. This is a connected, high-growth corridor where major logistics companies are already based. Your clients won't think it's too far west when their deliveries arrive faster. Your staff won't complain when the commute is freeway all the way. And you won't regret it when you're building equity instead of paying rent. Off-the-plan warehouses now available for owner-occupiers.
